fn step<'job>(&'job mut self,cx:&mut crate::StepContext<'_>,_:&mut crate::OriginalJobReturnClaim<'_>)->crate::InteractiveJobStep<'job>{self.calls+=1;crate::InteractiveJobStep::from_callback((||{let mut output=None;let turn=self.owner.take_step(&mut output,cx.retained_grant());let result=turn.result;cx.consume_fuel(turn.work);let p=result?.progress();cx.consume_retained(p)?;let mut failure=OriginalTurnFailure::from(output.take().expect("actual owned Fault transfer"));failure.effects=p;Err(failure)})())}

fn borrow_outcome<'job>(&'job self,_:&'job crate::JobOutcomeDescriptor)->Result<crate::JobOutcomeView<'job>,ValueError>{Err(ValueError::literal(semio_framework_value::ValueRefusalKind::UnsupportedOwner,"owned continuation has no semantic payload loan"))}
